title: Thermostat Probe Disagreement by Enclosure
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=reptilethermostat:event
| search probe_delta_c=*
| stats avg(probe_delta_c) as avg_probe_delta_c max(probe_delta_c) as max_probe_delta_c by enclosure_name
| sort 0 - avg_probe_delta_c
value: Probe disagreement is a strong hint that one sensor placement or device is no longer trustworthy.
implementation: Send probe disagreement events to `index=personal` and keep `enclosure_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of probe disagreement by enclosures.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers which enclosuress stand out most for probe disagreement.
